name: SS Pasteur
builder: Chantiers de Penhoët / Saint-Nazaire · yard designation R8 commonly cited
summary: Launched in 1938 and completed in 1939, she entered history at exactly the wrong moment for a peacetime prestige career: war intervened before her planned civilian service could properly develop, and the ship spent much of her early life not as a luxury liner but as a troopship and hospital ship.
